Delhi's Khan Market Ranks Among World's Top 25 Most Expensive Retail Streets

Delhi's Khan Market has been ranked as the 24th most expensive retail street globally, according to a report by Cushman & Wakefield. The report also indicated a 14% rise in rents for the market.
